info.title: Trvlrr API
info.description:
The API behind Trvlrr: a personal travel archive, trip planner and in-trip companion.
Everything is scoped to the caller's account; a trip shared with the caller is readable (or editable) on its own.

Dates are `YYYY-MM-DD`. Times are local to where the thing happens, as written on the booking (`HH:MM`; an
arrival on a later day is `HH:MM +1`), with an IANA zone beside each and a derived UTC instant (`*_utc`).
Countries: `country` on a trip place or stay is the readable name; every other country field is ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.
Prices are text with a currency, e.g. `AUD 420.00`. SQLite booleans are `0` or `1`.

Trvlrr Plus gates the planner, packing lists, photo search, faces, memories and voice: those routes answer 402
`upgrade_required`; AI routes answer 402 `usage_limit_reached` when the month's allowance is spent.
